# V-Memory Corp.

> V-Memory Corp. develops semiconductor technologies centered on FDWM (Ferroelectric Domain-Wall Memory) and V-ET (Thermoelectric Semiconductor Technology).

## Key Pages
- Main Portal: https://vmemory.net/
- AI Technical Reference (/llms/): https://vmemory.net/llms/
- V-ET Thermoelectric Page (/V-ET/): https://vmemory.net/V-ET/
- XML Sitemap: https://vmemory.net/sitemap.xml

## Core Technologies
- FDWM: Ferroelectric Domain-Wall Memory technology for high-speed, low-power memory and compute.
- V-ET: Solid-state thermoelectric cooling technology (Peltier effect; representative zT 1.3, R&D avg zT 1.4, achieved 4.3 W/cm^2, TIPS program 2020-2022, commercialized Nov 2022 as VET-WS07414606; wire-free socket V-ET SPACE and integrated cooling station in development).
